{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2014}}
{{Use British English|date=April 2014}}
The '''1977–78 Football League Cup''' was the 18th season of the [[EFL Cup|Football League Cup]], a knockout competition for England's top 92 football clubs. The competition started on 13 August 1977 and ended with the final going to a replay on 22 March 1978.

The final was contested by [[1977–78 Football League First Division|First Division]] teams [[Nottingham Forest F.C.|Nottingham Forest]] and [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] at [[Wembley Stadium (1923)|Wembley Stadium]] in London, followed by a replay at [[Old Trafford]].
